title: 3DAI Studio
short_description: AI-powered creative platform for NGOs & SPOs
long_description: 3DAI Studio is an AI-powered platform that enables users to generate visuals, 3D models, and creative assets, supporting faster content creation for digital use.

title: Ally
short_description: Mentorship and cohort management platform for nonprofits
long_description: Ally is a mentorship platform designed for nonprofits and social purpose organisations to manage mentor–mentee programmes, deliver structured learning experiences, and track participant progress across online and offline sessions.

title: Alteryx
short_description: Data analytics platform for nonprofit programme data
long_description: Alteryx is a data analytics platform that helps nonprofits prepare, combine, and analyse data from multiple sources. It enables teams to automate reporting workflows and generate insights without advanced coding.

title: Amazon Comprehend
short_description: A cloud-based NLP service that extracts insights, sentiment, entities, and key phrases from text at scale.
long_description: Amazon Comprehend is a natural language processing (NLP) service that uses machine learning to find insights and relationships in text. It can identify entities, key phrases, language, sentiment, and other elements within textual data.

title: Amazon Web Services
short_description: Cloud infrastructure platform for building and scaling digital systems
long_description: Amazon Web Services (AWS) provides on-demand cloud infrastructure such as servers, storage, and databases. It enables nonprofits to run applications, manage data, and scale digital systems without maintaining physical infrastructure.

title: Apache Superset
short_description: Data visualisation and dashboarding for nonprofits & SPOs
long_description: Apache Superset is an open-source business intelligence and data visualisation tool that enables organisations to explore data, build interactive dashboards, and generate insights for reporting and decision-making.

title: Asana
short_description: Work management platform for nonprofits
long_description: Asana is a cloud-based work management platform that helps organisations organise tasks, manage projects, and coordinate work across teams. It enables nonprofit organisations to plan, track, and manage programme work within a structured and collaborative workspace.

title: AssemblyAI
short_description: AI speech-to-text and audio analysis
long_description: AssemblyAI is an API-based tool for speech-to-text and audio analysis, offering features such as speaker diarisation, summarisation, and content moderation.

title: Avaza
short_description: Project management and collaboration for nonprofits
long_description: Avaza is a cloud-based platform that helps organisations manage projects, track tasks, collaborate with teams, and handle time tracking and invoicing within a single system. It can support nonprofit organisations in coordinating programme work and managing team activities.

title: Avni
short_description: Offline-first field data collection and beneficiary tracking platform for NGOs
long_description:
Avni is an open-source, offline-first platform designed for NGOs and social programmes in India to collect field data, track beneficiaries over time, and monitor programme delivery.

It enables organisations to design custom forms, collect data without internet access, and sync to a central dashboard. Unlike standard survey tools, Avni supports longitudinal tracking, allowing programmes to follow the same individual, household, or asset across multiple visits.

title: Basecamp
short_description: Collaboration Tool for Social Impact
long_description: Basecamp is a web-based project management and team collaboration tool. It provides features for message boards, to-do lists, schedules, document sharing, and group chat, helping teams simplify communication and organise work in one place.

title: Beautiful.ai
short_description: AI-assisted presentation design for nonprofits
long_description: Beautiful.ai is a presentation design platform that helps nonprofits and social purpose organisations create structured, visually consistent presentations. It uses AI-assisted layout and design suggestions to automatically adjust slides, reducing the need for manual formatting.

title: Beehive HRMS
short_description: HR and training management system for nonprofits and social purpose organisations.
long_description: Beehive HRMS is a cloud-based Human Resource Management System that enables organisations to manage payroll, attendance, compliance, and employee records within a single platform. It includes a training management module to track staff learning alongside core HR operations.

title: Better Together
short_description: Civic Engagement Platform for Volunteer & Fellowship Management, Community Building, and Social Impact Measurement.
long_description: Better Together is a whitelabelled civic engagement platform used by nonprofits, CSR foundations, and government bodies to manage volunteers and fellowship programmes, track participation, and measure social impact — all in one system.

title: Bigin by Zoho CRM
short_description: Relationship management for donors and stakeholders
long_description: Bigin by Zoho CRM is a pipeline-centric CRM software designed specifically for small businesses. It focuses on simplifying lead management, deal tracking, and contact organisation to help small teams manage their sales processes effectively.

title: Bolt.new
short_description: AI-assisted app and web development for nonprofits
long_description: Bolt.new is an AI-powered development tool that enables users to create web applications and interfaces using natural language prompts. It helps nonprofits and social purpose organisations build simple applications, prototypes, and tools without requiring extensive coding expertise.

title: Buffer
short_description: Social media scheduling and management for nonprofits
long_description: Buffer is a social media management platform that helps nonprofits and social purpose organisations plan, schedule, and publish content across multiple social media channels. It enables teams to maintain consistent communication and track performance from a single interface.

title: Calendly
short_description: Meeting scheduling automation tool for nonprofits and social purpose organisations.
long_description: Calendly is an automated scheduling software that simplifies the process of booking meetings and appointments. It allows users to set their availability and share links, enabling others to book times directly into their calendar without back-and-forth emails.

title: Campus Cloud (by Platform Commons)
short_description: School ERP and student information system for nonprofits & social purpose organisations
long_description: Campus Cloud is a school ERP and student information system developed by Platform Commons that helps organisations manage attendance, assessments, scheduling, learner performance, and communication through a centralised system.

title: Canva
short_description: Design and content creation for nonprofits
long_description: Canva is a design platform that helps nonprofits and social purpose organisations create visual content such as social media posts, presentations, posters, and reports. It provides templates, drag-and-drop editing, and collaboration features to support accessible content creation.

title: Canva AI 3D Model Generator
short_description: AI-powered design and 3D content creation for NGOs & SPOs.
long_description: Canva AI 3D Model Generator is part of Canva’s AI-powered design ecosystem, enabling users to create visual content and 3D-style assets quickly within a simple and collaborative platform.

title: ChartPixel
short_description: AI-assisted data visualisation and insights for nonprofits
long_description: ChartPixel is a data analysis tool that helps nonprofits and social purpose organisations upload datasets, generate visualisations, and explore insights using AI-assisted prompts. It enables teams to quickly create charts and summaries without requiring advanced data analysis skills.

title: Chat CSV
short_description: AI-powered data exploration for nonprofits working with spreadsheets
long_description: Chat CSV is an AI-powered tool that allows users to analyse and interact with CSV (spreadsheet) data using natural language. Instead of writing formulas or queries, teams can ask questions about their data and get instant insights, summaries, and visualisations. It is useful for nonprofits working with programme data, survey results, or operational datasets.

title: ChatGPT
short_description: AI assistant for content creation, research, and workflow support.
long_description: ChatGPT is an AI-powered conversational agent developed by OpenAI. It is designed to understand and generate human-like text based on the prompts it receives, capable of engaging in diverse conversations, providing information, and generating creative content.

title: Claude
short_description: AI assistant for writing, analysis, and content support for nonprofits
long_description: Anthropic’s Claude is a conversational AI assistant that helps nonprofits and social purpose organisations generate content, summarise information, and work with documents and data. It supports teams in turning scattered inputs into structured outputs and developing clear, usable narratives within existing workflows.

title: Clearscope
short_description: AI-powered content optimisation and SEO platform.
long_description: Clearscope helps organisations create high-ranking, relevant content by analysing top search results and providing keyword and content recommendations.

title: ClickTime
short_description: Time tracking and labour cost management for nonprofits.
long_description: ClickTime is a cloud-based platform used by nonprofits and social purpose organisations to track staff time, allocate labour costs to programmes, and generate reports for financial management and compliance.

title: ClickUp
short_description: Productivity platform for social impact
long_description: ClickUp is a cloud-based project management and productivity platform that combines tasks, collaboration, documents, and reporting within a single workspace.

title: Collaborate
short_description: Project tracking for development sector
long_description: Collaborate is a project management software platform by Platform Commons that supports project planning, task assignment, progress tracking, team collaboration, and reporting in one place.

title: CommCare
short_description: Digital case management and field operations platform for NGOs
long_description:
CommCare is a digital case management and field operations platform designed for NGOs, governments, and social enterprises to manage beneficiary data, deliver services, and monitor programmes in low-connectivity environments.

It enables organisations to digitise frontline workflows, track beneficiaries over time, and support field workers with guided mobile applications. Unlike survey tools, CommCare maintains persistent case records, allowing programmes to manage ongoing service delivery across multiple interactions.

title: Commons.farm
short_description: Farm management and data platform for organisations working with smallholder farmers and agriculture programmes.
long_description: Commons.farm is a platform within the broader "Platform Commons" initiative, designed to support the agricultural sector. It provides digital infrastructure and applications to facilitate interactions between ground workforce professionals and farmers, managing processes like farmer onboarding, crop planning, inventory, and transactions, with a focus on improving agricultural workflows.

title: Copy.ai
short_description: An AI-powered copywriting tool for generating marketing content, blogs, and social media posts quickly.
long_description: Copy.ai is an AI-powered content generation tool that helps users create marketing copy, blog posts, social media content, and other written materials. It leverages artificial intelligence to generate text based on user inputs and templates.

title: D-ID
short_description: Converts text, images, or audio into talking avatar videos, enabling quick, low-effort content creation.
long_description: D-ID is an AI-powered platform that enables the creation of talking avatars and video content from text, images, or audio. It helps organisations convert static content into engaging video formats without requiring traditional video production.

title: DALL·E 3
short_description: DALL·E 3 generates images from text prompts, helping nonprofits create custom visuals quickly without design skills.
long_description: DALL·E 3 is an AI-based image generation tool that creates visuals from text prompts. It enables nonprofit organisations to generate custom images for communication, campaigns, and content without requiring design expertise.

title: DaanVeda
short_description: AI-powered donor intelligence and prospecting platform for NGOs
long_description:
DaanVeda is an AI-driven donor intelligence platform designed for Indian NGOs. It enables organisations to identify potential donors, match with CSR opportunities, and build fundraising proposals using structured data and AI-supported workflows.

DaanVeda is not a crowdfunding or donation marketplace platform. Its primary role is donor discovery and prospecting, with campaign execution and donation workflows as supporting capabilities.

title: Dalgo
short_description: Data pipelines and analytics for NGO data systems
long_description: Dalgo is a data platform developed by Project Tech4Dev that supports nonprofits in integrating and managing data from multiple sources. It enables organisations to set up data pipelines, prepare datasets, and support reporting and analysis workflows.

title: Danamojo
short_description: Digital fundraising and donation management platform for nonprofits
long_description: Danamojo is a platform designed for nonprofit organisations in India to collect donations online, run fundraising campaigns, and maintain donor records in a structured way.

title: DeepL
short_description: Translation and language support for NGOs and social purpose organisations.
long_description: DeepL is an AI-powered machine translation service known for its high-quality and nuanced translations. It uses neural network technology to provide accurate and natural-sounding translations across multiple languages.
